<!--
  STAGED RELEASE - only the Week 2 slides are live. Every other week is
  wrapped in an HTML comment below and does not render.

  To reveal a week, delete the two marker lines around it: the opening line
  that reads "HIDDEN - Week N" and the closing marker on its own line just
  after that week's last entry. Then re-render. To hide a week again, wrap it
  back up the same way. Keep each week in its own block so they can be
  released one at a time.

  This hides the LINKS only. The .pdf and .pptx files themselves still sit in
  docs/lecture_slides/ and are still served by GitHub Pages, so anyone with a
  direct URL (or an earlier deploy, or the git history) can still reach them.
  If a deck must be genuinely unavailable, remove the file, not just the link.

  One trap: a comment ends at the FIRST closing marker, so never let two
  hyphens followed by a right angle bracket appear inside a hidden block. It
  would end the comment early and dump the rest of the page out as raw text.
  The week sections below are plain links and headings, so none of them
  contain that sequence today - check before pasting anything new in.
-->
